description: This file defines the ResolveReferencesInSort class, a component of Spark SQL's query analysis phase responsible for resolving column references in ORDER BY clauses within logical plans, handling various resolution scenarios including unresolved ordinals, attribute references, aggregate functions, and special cases like 'ALL'.

classes.name: ResolveReferencesInSort
classes.description: A class that resolves column references in Sort nodes within Spark SQL's logical plan, considering various resolution rules and handling special cases like 'ALL'.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method to resolve references in a Sort plan, either returning the plan unchanged if unresolved ordinals are prioritized or resolving references directly.

methods.name: hasUnresolvedOrdinals
methods.description: Checks if the Sort plan contains any UnresolvedOrdinal expressions in its order list.

methods.name: resolveReferencesInSort
methods.description: Performs the detailed resolution of column references within a Sort plan, including handling aggregate functions and missing attributes.

methods.name: resolveOrderByAll
methods.description: Expands 'ORDER BY ALL' to include all columns from the child's output, maintaining order direction and null ordering.
